findings.description: From 00:00 to 07:50 the coat on the brass hook is plain dark navy and hangs mostly left of/centered under the hook, with its whole length visible down to the frame bottom and no markings. When the camera follows the man to the neighboring door (from ~08:25 through 09:75), the same coat on the same hook, at a similar scale, drapes noticeably to the right of the hook and has a bold cream/white diagonal stripe across its lower half that was never visible before. Nobody touches the coat, so the change in markings and drape is unexplained.
